observations.why: The first-person plural with a decisive verb enacts collective authority — the speaker commits the group to a decision, performing hierarchical command through we-ness.
Proportionality framing — quantified benefit and cost reduction justify the switch in cost/benefit terms.
The arrow notation enacts a directive transition — a mandated migration path stated as decision, performing authority-ranking.
Quantified performance gain framed as proportional return — market-pricing proportionality.
A fixed deadline imposed on the collective enacts authority-ranking — the speaker sets a temporal mandate binding the group.
